pr_title: Proper behavior of Eurotronic SPZB0001 that doesn't support presetmodes or have heat as boost mode in deCONZ integration
pr_body:

## Breaking change
nothing

## Proposed change
In a nutshell _Add a setting to deconz intigration for remap modes to match the device_

As an example Euronics Spirit has no preset modes, and mode heat is boost, auto means controlled by the target temperature and off is off. So auto is the default mode on this devices and the devices self has two types of modes Heat and Off.
DECONZ | off -> No heating -> off | HA
DECONZ | auto -> Heating to defined target temperature -> heat | HA
DECONZ | heat -> Set target to 30°C boost heat -> boost | HA

It should be possible to tell HA to interpret the auto mode as heating mode. This is not only for HA, if GA Intigration is used, it's not possible to controll the target temperature with Google Assistient as the mode is set to auto and auto in google means controlled by AI, but the Spirit still uses a target set temperature in "deconz auto mode".

I also added a min and max temp setting for GA because deconz uses 5°C - 30°C and GA default 10°C - 32°C

issue_context.title: deConz thermostat integration for thermostats that havn't preset like Spirit or heat means boost
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The PR #26267 has intigratet the auto mode to deconz Euronics Zigbee devices. And it works fine if HA only is used. but in combination with the Google Assistian that dosn't work. Because the Euronics Spirit has no preset modes, and mode heat is boost, auto means controlled by the target temperature and off is off.

So auto is the default mode on this devices but for GA auto means AI controlled stuff and you can't control the target temperature.

For that usecase the deconz mode auto should be remapped to heat in HA and so the correct mode is also reported to GA.
As an example Euronics Spirit Zigbee has 3 states in deconz.
off -> No heating
auto -> Heating to defined target temperature
heat -> Set target to 30°C boost heat

i wrote a little pull #47767 request to add a option to deconz intigration to toggle between "presetmode style" and auto = heat mapping. To fix this problem.

I also added a min and max Temp to the GA intigration because it currently relates to display bugs in GA default min temp is 10°C and HA uses 5°C see [screenshot](https://www.dropbox.com/s/i1q7vlricbnbz74/Screenshot_20210311-143734_2.png)

And fix sync modes, GA require a array. A comma seperated list is deprecated.

Setup for control Euronics Spirit Zigbee over Google Assistiant

deconz -> HA -> GA

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.3.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2021.3.3

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

deconz

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/deconz/
